paragraphs: Mentioned in Bava Kamma 99b: a man who was a money changer in the time of Rav Papa.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The William Davidson vocalized text of Bava Kamma 99b explicitly names Rav Papa discussing Danku and Issur as expert money changers.

The saved Davidson Bava Kamma99b scalar explicitly names Rav Papa discussing Danku and Issur as experts, supporting the ר״פ expansion. The older registry-based uncertainty remains archived; this local expansion relies on the named occurrence and does not retire that historical note.

Hyman’s money-changer and in Rav Papa’s time descriptions are retained. The99b locator is supported by the named digital response; this updates the older unverified-locator note without claiming printed verification or importing the surrounding liability discussion.
